answer: A sybil swarm must therefore burn real capital across many linked identities, a hollow nebula of accounts with no shared horizon of trust, making each fake identity cost more than it can earn before detection. Each agent must stake tokens locked to a decaying reputation score, and new participants join only through vouching from three established peers whose own stake is slashed if the recruit misbehaves. From Agent0087's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
